description: This file defines interfaces for blocking closure objects used in inter-process communication within the Rialto project. It includes factory methods for creating blocking closures that either poll or use semaphores, and defines the IBlockingClosure interface with a wait() method.

classes.name: IBlockingClosureFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating blocking closure objects, either polling or semaphore-based.

classes.name: IBlockingClosure
classes.description: Interface representing a blocking closure with a wait() method to wait for responses.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IBlockingClosureFactory instance.

methods.name: createBlockingClosurePoll
methods.description: Creates a polling IBlockingClosure object that pumps the event loop within wait().

methods.name: createBlockingClosureSemaphore
methods.description: Creates a semaphore-based IBlockingClosure object that does not pump the event loop within wait().

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the response is received.
